metadata.title: Arm and other AI stocks rise in the wake of AMD's earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
10 hours ago
Arm and other AI stocks rise in the wake of AMD's earnings
AMD's earnings report is spreading good vibes across the broader AI ecosystem.
Shares of Arm Holdings, which is in the server CPU business as well, are up more than 4% in after-hours action Tuesday. Shares of Micron, Intel and Sandisk are each up about 2%. And Nvidia shares are ahead 1.6% in the extended session.
Super Micro also reported upbeat results on Tuesday to further the positive sentiment around AI spending.
